150210102.text: Yup! And it looks like we made it just in time! Although... can't say the same for the qucusaurs. Bit of a low turnout, huh?

150210103.text: Yeah... You'll see why soon enough.

150210104.text: Alright, get ready! Three, two, one... fly!

150210106.text: I feel light as a feather... Haha, I'm flying without a qucusaur!

150210109.text: Paimon can barely believe her eyes... How did they fly all on their own?

150210110.text: What happened while we were gone?

150210111.text: The merchants we ran into that day were selling a product called "Phlogiston Wings."

150210112.text: It's a flying machine worn on the back. To operate it, you just use a hand-held trackball that controls the flow of gaseous phlogiston.

150210114.text: Yeah. If our tribe — well, if Natlan mass-adopted this technology, it would revolutionize our mobility and responsiveness in times of crisis...

150210115.text: ...Just think of the countless tragedies that could be averted.

150210117.text: I... I feel like I'm dreaming... Did I really just... fly on my own? Without the help of a qucusaur?

150210118.text: You'd better believe it! Plus, you just passed the flying trial! Right, Elder Allpa?

150210121.text: Um... Should this really count as a pass, if we did the trial using Phlogiston Wings?

150210122.text: Why not? The scoring rubric is about flying performance. It doesn't specifically say you have to ride a qucusaur, does it?

150210123.text: Maybe, but... I mean, even Chasca had to ride a qucusaur in her trial, right? And the whole point of the trial is to test both your flying technique, and your ability to work with a saurian companion.

150210124.text: Well, if we can fly by ourselves... maybe we don't have to test the latter anymore.

150210125.text: #Chasca, {NICKNAME}, what are your thoughts on this new invention?

150210130.text: Hmm... I agree that they have strategic value. But I don't think it makes any sense to evaluate candidates by the current testing standards if they're using Phlogiston Wings.

150210132.text: Whyyy? Zhunan finally mustered the courage to go through with this, and now you're saying it doesn't count!?

150210133.text: We don't have any experience using these wings in battle, nor is it immediately obvious how to incorporate them into the existing systems in our tribe.

150210134.text: Taking a longer-term perspective, I think we need to start by getting thoroughly acquainted with how these things work. Then we can develop a new trial format with new assessment criteria, tailored to candidates using the Phlogiston Wings.

150210135.text: Mmm... You all raise valid points. But Chasca, while your proposal sounds perfectly reasonable, it would probably take years to put it into practice.

150210136.text: We lost so many people in that war... These Phlogiston Wings could be exactly what we need to strengthen our forces and boost morale in this trying time.

150210137.text: And as for real-world battle experience... There will be plenty of opportunities to gain that. I have high hopes for you, Zhunan.

150210139.text: Hey... Stop staring into space! Say "thank you"!

150210140.text: Oh, uh — thank you! Thank you, Elder Allpa!

150210141.text: You have nothing to thank me for. Remember... the way you got your wings back was by relying on yourself.

150210142.text: ...Elder Allpa! Bad news — qucusaurs are attacking the merchants again!

150210143.text: Again? Okay, everyone stay put while I— Hmm?

150210129.text: Right? That's what I think, too...

150210201.text: It's back... It found us again!

150210204.text: Curses... She's really riled up this time!

150210205.text: Hey, stop running! We'll never outrun a creature with wings! Get back here and let's fight!

150210208.text: ...Chasca! Wonderful! Quick, get rid of that thing...

150210211.text: Uhh... What's going on? Why isn't she doing anything?

150210214.text: Wait, "sister"? That qucusaur is Chasca's sister?

150211102.text: Phew... I'm fine, sorry for making you worry.

150211103.text: You're not going to keep following her?

150211104.text: No point. She's an expert at hiding her tracks. Once she's shaken you off, you'll never catch up to her.

150211105.text: ...At least, I always used to lose to her at hide-and-seek when we were kids.

150211107.text: Well, yeah. You know I was raised by qucusaurs. Anyway, she and I grew up in the nest together... her name's Coya, and she's my "big sister."

150211108.text: We played together all the time, chasing each other through treetops, or mountaintops. It felt like it would go on that way forever... Until the day I was sent back to live with the humans.

150211109.text: Not all qucusaurs are friendly towards people. Coya, for instance — she's fine with me, because we grew up around each other, but she's not fond of other humans.

150211110.text: When "Mom" decided to send me away, Coya strongly protested, and after I left, she became more and more reluctant to interact with humans...

150211111.text: Maybe she thinks that... humans stole you away from her?

150211112.text: ...It's a possibility. But in any case, we still stayed best friends at first.

150211113.text: I had a hard time adjusting to life in the tribe, so whenever something went wrong, I'd run off into the wild and vent to Coya.

150211114.text: Ah, so that's what Uncle Cusco was talking about. He said you seemed to prefer hanging out with saurians to your own kind back then.

150211115.text: Yeah, I did... but then gradually, everything changed. With a new mom and dad, a new tribe, and Chuychu...

150211116.text: I started getting curious about these humans, and made an effort to understand their behavior. The more time I spent with them, the less I spent with Coya...

150211117.text: And then, one day... it was Coya's turn to leave the nest. She sought me out and asked if I was willing to leave the tribe and go live in the wilderness with her.

150211118.text: As far as I can remember... That was the first time she ever approached a human settlement on purpose.

150211119.text: So... how did you answer her?

150211120.text: Well, I wouldn't be standing here talking to you if I'd said yes.

150211121.text: In other words, you turned her down?

150211122.text: No, I... I was torn. On the one hand, I'd already made up my mind to embrace my new family, and accept my human identity.

150211123.text: But I also knew that Coya wasn't a fan of humans, and I didn't want to disappoint her... *sigh* She took my hesitation as an answer.

150211124.text: She saw it as a personal betrayal, threw a huge fit, and then flew off. We hadn't seen each other since... until today.

150211125.text: Not for lack of trying, though. I tried asking Mom where Coya's new nest was so I could talk things out with her. But Coya had already asked Mom not to tell me where she'd moved to.

150211126.text: It must be hard for Mom, being stuck between her two daughters, so I didn't press the issue, and I didn't go looking for her.

150211128.text: Mm, if things carry on like this, I need to make sure I find her before anyone else... Even if she doesn't want to see me.

150211129.text: For now, let's bring the wounded back to the tribe, and see what Mutota and Elder Allpa have in mind.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the Flower-Feather Clan to discuss the situation

150210301.text: After tending to the wounded, Mutota gathers everyone for a meeting...

150210302.text: ...So, I hear there's been another Qucusaur attack.

150210303.text: Hah, I knew it! They're wild animals, and they can't be trusted!

150210304.text: Hey! Show a little respect, the qucusaurs are our partners!

150210305.text: Hmph, maybe in the flying squad, but they don't give a hoot about the rest of us!

150210306.text: Well, now that we have the Phlogiston Wings... Do we even need the qucusaurs anymore?

150210307.text: Are you kidding? How are we supposed to protect our tribe without them?

150210309.text: Huh! "Protect our tribe"? Or are you just scared that your precious flying squad will lose its prestigious position?

150210312.text: Chasca, there's a conflict emerging there... aren't you going to nip it in the bud?

150210313.text: The whole tribe's talking about this now — breaking up a single fight won't solve anything. The real source of conflict here is the Phlogiston Wings... and what happened with Coya.

150210314.text: On any other day, people would just brush this attack aside. After all, clashes between wild qucusaurs and humans are no more common than those between people.

150210315.text: But now that the Phlogiston Wings have entered the equation, it's sparked a debate over whether our tribe needs the qucusaurs at all...

150210316.text: I worry that we risk repeating the mistakes of the Cinder City... Back then, Lord Och-Kan's hatred of the saurians nearly destroyed the peace forged by the Pyro Archon...

150210317.text: Chasca, to prevent things from deteriorating further, I'd like to task you with restoring peace to the tribe.

150210319.text: #{NICKNAME}, you've already done so much for Natlan, and the Flower-Feather Clan has no right to ask more of you, but...

150210325.text: And don't forget about Paimon! Just leave this to us.

150210326.text: ...This whole situation has unfolded so quickly that it's put us on the back foot. To tell the truth, it makes me a little suspicious...

150210327.text: You think someone might have orchestrated all this?

150210328.text: It's possible... Leave it with me. I'll look into it.

150210329.text: Also, Chasca... Could you try to keep a low profile while you're out there digging around? We don't want to give our hand away.

150210331.text: Okay... So where should we start?

150210332.text: This all began with Coya's attacks. If we can find out what led her to do it, that should give us something to work with.

150210333.text: But will she even talk to us?

150210334.text: ...Unlikely. Given how she reacted when I showed up, I don't think she's forgiven me.

150210335.text: If you want to resolve a conflict through dialogue, sometimes you need a third-party facilitator... Let's go see my "mom."

150210324.text: Heh... Looks like I was making a mountain out of a mole-hill.

150210401.text: Wow, so this is where you used to live as a child?

150210402.text: Mm-hmm... When I was little, we used to do this thing where I'd jump from the top of this tree, and Coya would fly over from the platform and catch me in midair.

150210403.text: Or sometimes, we'd both fly from the treetop together, then after some aerial maneuvering, she'd throw me up onto that platform.

150210404.text: After we got a bit older, we went to the nearby shores looking for even greater heights...

150210405.text: Aah, stop! You're gonna give Paimon a heart attack...

150210406.text: Oh, really? I just thought it made a fun story...

150210408.text: Then I'll share some more with you when there's time. Anyway... back to the matter at hand.

150210414.text: Hey, Momma Bird, I'm back. My last visit was only a week ago, wasn't it? See, I visit you more than I visit Papa Cusco.

150210415.text: #I brought a couple of friends with me. These are {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

150210416.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, this is my Mom. Her name is... "Chimpu." In the human tongue, anyway.

150210420.text: No, not really... I don't speak it as such, but I can sort of get the gist — although, only with Mom and Coya, since I spent my formative years with them.

150210421.text: Even then, it's basically a best-guess based on their sounds, body language, and expressions. Seems to work about nine times out of ten, anyway.

150210422.text: As for whether Mom understands me, I can't always tell. But somehow, we still manage to communicate... Call it the family bond, I guess.

150210424.text: Don't worry, I'm doing well. But... I think Coya might be in some trouble.

150210425.text: Chasca explains the situation to Chimpu through a series of gestures...

150210426.text: ...I know she's never been a fan of humans, but she's never deliberately attacked them before, either. What's behind this sudden change?

150210428.text: Does, um... Auntie Chimpu know anything?

150210429.text: ...Doesn't look like it. Coya hasn't visited her in a long time.

150210430.text: ...Then, could you please tell me where she's living nowadays? I really need to talk to her.

150210431.text: If this animosity between her and the tribe continues, then... the next time there's an incident, I don't know if I'll make it there in time.

150210410.text: What, you too? Alright, fine... let's focus on the matter at hand.

150210501.text: This is a really remote location... Guess she was trying to get as far away from humans as possible.

150210503.text: ...We stay here? Mm... Okay, got it.

150210504.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, Mom says we should stay out of sight for now. She'll talk to Coya first.

150210505.text: Coya is very hostile toward humans right now, so if we show up unannounced, it might just make things worse.

150210511.text: Uhhh... Any idea what they're saying?

150210512.text: Hmm... Sounds like things are more complicated than I imagined.

150210513.text: ...There's evidence in this area suggesting that Coya might have been the victim of a human attack.

150210519.text: It's Chime, Coya's child... the attackers kidnapped her!

150210520.text: "They came over the sea... under the cover of night... and they took Chime."

150210521.text: What the heck? Who would do such a thing!?

150210522.text: "I searched day and night... and finally found them..."

150210526.text: Oh, yeah! Tepal's contraption is working like a charm! Got 'er in one!

150210527.text: Hey, there's another one... Wait, is that the one that got away last time?

150210528.text: Who cares, just get 'em all! Tepal pays us per catch!

150210902.text: We're okay, no serious injuries... Thank goodness you all got here just in time.

150210701.text: D—Don't come any closer, or I'll... Uhh, go, Phlogiston Wings, take me outta here! ...Aah!

150210703.text: (This is bad... Mom and Coya are already injured, and if that thing explodes right next to them...)

150210704.text: Help! Uh, Elemental Energy suppresses it! Please, someone—

150210707.text: Uh... It's still going... And it's getting worse!

150210708.text: Guess we need a more permanent solution. Alright then...

150210710.text: Chasca throws the malfunctioning trackball into the distance... Moments later, a huge explosion rings out over the ocean.

150210712.text: That was too close... I thought I was gonna die...

150210715.text: Answer us honestly. Were you the ones who attacked Coya before?

150210716.text: I, um... No, it was, it was...

150210718.text: Well, she says it was you.

150210721.text: Just tell me. Who sent you here?

150210722.text: I—It was Tepal! He told us to catch all the wild qucusaurs we can find!

150210723.text: And... he also said that this qucusaur has become a thorn in his side... so it needs dealing with urgently...

150210724.text: "Tepal"? Huh, sounds familiar... But where from...?

150210726.text: Um... He tends to send his orders in writing...

150210727.text: He pretty much never communicates with us in person. When he does, he wears a mask to hide his face...

150210728.text: And whenever we trade qucusaurs for Phlogiston Wings, we deal with his henchmen.

150210729.text: So you didn't even make those wings!

150210730.text: All we did was slap some labels on them and transport them over here, to make them look like they're imported...

150210731.text: ...To make it harder to trace their origins.

150210732.text: Why does he want you to catch qucusaurs?

150210734.text: Well, that's mighty convenient, huh? What about if I held a gun to your head, would that change your answer?

150210735.text: N—No need! I'm sorry, I'll tell you everything I know!

150210736.text: Tepal doesn't tell us much, but he's always stressing that he wants them alive... So that gives us some clues...

150210737.text: This is just a best guess, of course, but we suspect that the gaseous phlogiston stored in the trackballs... is drawn directly from the qucusaurs.

150210740.text: Easy now, you're still injured... Hey, keep talking.

150210741.text: Yes Ma'am... So, the gaseous phlogiston has to be highly refined in order to power the Phlogiston Wings. The slightest imperfection can have disastrous consequences, as you just witnessed...

150210742.text: But the qucusaurs have a natural ability to process gaseous phlogiston, so... if you use them as an intermediary, then...

150210744.text: That's enough... So, the qucusaurs you took. Where are they now?

150210745.text: Uh... Tepal should have them... But no one knows where he's based apart from him and his henchmen.

150210746.text: We've tried looking for it ourselves. Even followed them a few times. But we always end up losing track of them...

150210747.text: Random thought: Maybe they're hiding up in the sky...?

150210748.text: I guess this means we can't go after the ringleader yet.

150210749.text: Tepal... Tepal... I'm sure I've heard that name. Maybe it was...

150210752.text: Elder Allpa? What brings you all the way out here?

150210753.text: Well, I was patrolling nearby when I heard the sound of an explosion... What's going on?

150210755.text: You explain Tepal's scheme to Allpa...

150210757.text: Elder Allpa, does the name "Tepal" ring a bell to you? I feel like I've seen it written down before... maybe in a list of candidates for the flying trials.

150210758.text: Huh? So he's a member of your tribe, then?

150210759.text: No... If he was a member of the Flower-Feather Clan, I'd definitely know him.

150210760.text: Shall we head back to the tribe and do some investigating?

150210762.text: ...Now that you mention it, I do remember a young man from outside our tribe who came to participate in our flying trials once.

150210763.text: You were away on a mission at the time, which is probably why you don't remember him.

150210764.text: He was a craftsman from the Children of Echoes, but he'd always dreamed of soaring the skies. So he wanted to join our flying squad.

150210765.text: The Children of Echoes? That's rare.

150210766.text: But despite his best efforts, he unfortunately failed to pass the trial and gain the qucusaurs' approval.

150210767.text: In the end, he went wingless, and returned dejected to the Children of Echoes.

150210768.text: Wingless, huh... Maybe he invented the Phlogiston Wings to get revenge on the qucusaurs?

150210769.text: Perhaps... or maybe it's simply his way of dealing with his regrets over his past flying endeavors.

150210770.text: ...Either way, it doesn't excuse his abuse of the qucusaurs. I'm gonna take these guys back and expose the truth to the tribe. It's time for this conflict to end.

150210772.text: Easy, Chasca. Remember what I said about keeping a low profile?

150210773.text: The ringleader still hasn't shown himself, and this man's allegation about powering the Phlogiston Wings with qucusaurs is only speculation.

150210774.text: Bringing these men to the tribe now won't win over any current supporters of the Phlogiston Wings. In fact, it may even escalate the conflict further.

150210775.text: ...After all, many are mistrustful of the qucusaurs after recent events.

150210776.text: ...Is that why Tepal waited until now to try to capture my sister?

150210777.text: I—I don't know! I mean, he did tell us to spread negative rumors about the qucusaurs, and slip some Mora to anyone opposed to them, but...

150210778.text: But Coya only attacked humans because they stole her child!

150210779.text: Nevertheless, we will be hard-pressed to change people's minds while emotions are running high — unless we have irrefutable evidence...

150210780.text: ...You mean, we need to catch Tepal himself?

150210781.text: Bravo, my thoughts exactly. In the meantime, leave these men with me — I'll escort them back to the tribe.

150210782.text: I'll take the other members of their crew into custody, too. They won't get another chance to stir up trouble.

150210783.text: Fair enough... I guess finding Tepal is gonna be the key to resolving this conflict. Let's hope the Children of Echoes have some info on him.

150210785.text: Sorry, whatever it is, it'll have to wait till this has all blown over. I have to fix this situation before it spirals out of control...

150210787.text: Mom, Sis... rest up, and get well soon. I gotta fly.

150210788.text: Everyone departs, leaving only Chimpu and Coya...

150210790.text: (...If you're worried, go ahead and follow her.)

150210791.text: (Don't worry about me. Mom can take care of herself.)

150211001.text: What was wrong with that qucusaur? Why was it so aggressive?

150211002.text: If we just let it escape back into the wild, who's to say it won't attack again?

150219801.text: The Flower-Feather Clan should be about ready to hold the new flying trials by now. Let's go check it out!

150219901.text: Why did Chasca rush off like that? And then Elder Allpa and the others, too... Anyway, let's go see what this is all about!

150219902.text: Is Chasca gonna be okay? Should we go check on her?

150219903.text: Ch—Chasca!? How'd you get here... Quick! Stop her!

150219904.text: Don't you even think about running away!
